# Touch timer re-arm

Shared touch code re-arms event 500 at 8000 ms here after a tap.

**Category:** hook site · **Address:** `0x612a8db3` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

Takes id and time from a record filled by 0x612ae7a1, in touch layout 28 (vtable 0x61639130). Caduceus hooks this call to give Picture Mode 30 s on a tap and leaves other screens unchanged.

## Observations

- **Emulator** ([Caduceus for OM-3](../projects/caduceus-om3.md)): A tap on a COLOR tab reaches this re-arm; of 35 touch layouts only layout 28 re-arms id 500. Source: [OM-3 research notebook](../sources/om3.notes.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus for OM-3](../projects/caduceus-om3.md)): With the hook, a tap gives Picture Mode 30 s; other touch menus close after 8 s. Source: [OM-3 research notebook](../sources/om3.notes.md).
